title: Chapter 119: He Has Returned
html:
“He smashed his head against the wall? As if something had burrowed into his brain?”

The account reminded Chen Ge of Zhang Peng. Both men had been possessed, but while Zhang Peng had embraced the creature, Wang Haiming had fought it.

Yin energy peaked at midnight, when such entities were most active. That would explain why Wang Haiming’s episodes always began around then.

Chen Ge decided to continue this line of questioning. “Boss, other than the nightly madness, did Wang Haiming perform any other weird actions?”

“When he first left the hospital, he seemed normal—quiet, perhaps, but nothing worse. Only after we spent time around him did we realize how disturbed he was. During the day, he might even greet us. At night, he became another person. He smashed his head against the wall, talked to mirrors and empty rooms, and strangled himself until his face turned purple, yet still refused to let go.”

The story clarified Wang Haiming’s past. His second wife had taken his money and committed him. If she had framed him, then he might have entered the hospital perfectly sane. A normal man had gone in and something else had come out.

He must have brought that thing back from the hospital.As the answer settled in Chen Ge’s mind, he asked, “Can you tell me how Wang Haiming died?”

The man lifted his bottle and took a long drink. “I don’t know why you care so much about a dead man, but listen to me: get out while you still can. This place is cursed.”

“Thank you, but I know what I’m doing.”

After more persuasion, the man finally relented. “Whenever Wang Haiming had an episode, we heard him screaming. The tenants would rush over to help or call the police. But the night he died, none of us heard a sound. When the landlady brought him food the next morning, his body was already cold.”

“What did the scene of his death look like?” Chen Ge asked. This was crucial if he wanted to reconstruct what happened to Wang Haiming.

The man regarded him curiously, unable to understand the young man’s morbid interest. “I was there. Wang Haiming had a deep wound in his forehead, and blood covered the wall between 303 and 304. His face was purple, as if he’d suffocated. There were fingerprints around his neck, but the police said they were his own.”

“So, he strangled himself to death?”

“The room was locked, and he was alone. No one had tampered with the door or windows, so that was the only logical conclusion.” The man drained his beer and tossed the bottle aside. “Are we done? I want to buy more while the sun is still up.”

“While the sun is still up?” Chen Ge glanced at the darkening sky. “One last question. Has anything strange happened here since Wang Haiming died?”

The man’s expression changed. He glanced at the money in his hand and lowered his voice. “Several longtime tenants swear they’ve seen Wang Haiming come back.”

“But isn’t he dead?”

Before Chen Ge had finished, the man pushed him out of the room.

“Hey! Explain yourself!”

The man was already hurrying down the corridor. After a moment’s hesitation, Chen Ge headed for the landlady’s room on the first floor. If Wang Haiming had come from the Third Sick Hall, he might have left behind information about it. Chen Ge refused to abandon the trail his parents had given him.

The moment the landlady understood his intentions, she reacted with startling hostility and threatened to call the police unless he left at once.

The steel door slammed in his face. Nothing he said would persuade her to cooperate.

If I break Room 303’s lock with the mallet, she’ll definitely call the police.

Chen Ge returned to the third floor to discuss this with Doctor Gao, but he stopped when he reached the door.

Why is the man in Room 302 still on the phone?A young voice drifted through the door, repeating the same question: “Are you trying to drive me to my death?”

It’s been more than half an hour since I left Men Nan’s room. Is he still on the same call?Long conversations were common, but repeating the same few lines over and over was not.

Who is he arguing with? I can hear only his voice—and listening closely, it doesn’t sound as though he’s on the phone at all.Chen Ge pressed his ear to the door and remembered the middle-aged man’s story: during his episodes, Wang Haiming had argued with himself.

This man is suspicious.He knocked, and the argument stopped at once. Ten seconds later, the door opened a crack. “How can I help you?”

“Regarding this Room 303 next to you…”

“Don’t know.”

The door closed before Chen Ge could finish. Having questioned everyone he could, he was running out of options. He returned to Room 304, nodded to Doctor Gao, and leaned against the door.

The black phone identified Room 303 as the mission site. I have to get inside before midnight.Chen Ge rubbed his eyes, crossed to the window, and pushed it open. The windows of Rooms 303 and 304 stood only a meter apart.

I can make that.He pulled a chair to the window and tested the reach. Room 303’s window was unlocked, allowing him to pull it open from outside.

Crossing over is easy. Getting back while something chases me might not be.He looked down. Three stories was neither impossibly high nor safely low, and unlike Ping An Apartments, Hai Ming’s courtyard was paved with concrete.
